score: 288/316 projects reduced, 0 wrong; 30% of project complexity removed (21% by dropping unneeded actions alone)
metric: A Dataform project and the outputs to keep: kumosql.project_reduction returns a patch on its .sqlx files that deletes what the kept outputs do not need and folds, merges, prunes and simplifies the rest, every step proved. Complexity is project_score (sqlfluff structure of every action plus one per action), summed over the cases; the baseline only drops unneeded actions (reduce-project --drop-only).
correctness: 0 wrong: every patch is accepted by git apply and every reduced project re-proves each kept output against the original after it is reloaded (316/316). The 270 converted table-minimization projects and the 6 Jaffle Shop cases are also compiled by the harness and run on DuckDB (optimizer off): converted cases on targeted, 60 random and every trap-witness database, Jaffle Shop on its seed data and 60 random databases; no kept output and no surviving assertion differs. Negative control: the first trap of 6 dev cases, written as a patched project, is counted wrong, and so is a project that lost a kept output. Proofs are as sound as KumoSQL's prover.
held_out: 70 cases (64 converted, 6 real-project selections), run once: 66/70 reduced, 0 wrong, 70/70 re-proved; converted complexity -29.1% (dropping alone -10.2%), quality 0.69
caveats: Converted cases are the table-minimization cases written as Dataform projects with assertions, project variables, incremental tables and dependencies mixed in by a hash of the case id; the 40 real cases are kept-output selections over the 8 open-source projects in tests/fixtures/bq_corpora (proved, not executed, since there is no data) and Jaffle Shop is one small dbt project. The reducer was developed on dev cases; this change was evaluated on dev and then held out once, with no individual held-out case inputs or transformations reviewed or tuned. An exact string literal containing one project-variable token is represented as an unknown value; embedded, raw, bytes, triple-quoted and adjacent-string forms stay as written. No dev case gained a new shared table; one held-out case reused an existing one. This run follows the 2026-10-04 complexity-score update (comma-joined FROM items count as joins, IF() as a CASE). The adapted table-minimization cases (sourced-*.jsonl) are not part of this eval.
usefulness: 288/316 dev projects reduced, 243 beyond dropping unneeded actions: converted 250/270 (complexity 5,056.5 -> 3,459.0, -31.6%; dropping alone -14.2%; 233 beyond dropping; 71.6% of the minimization reference reduction), real projects 32/40 (5,255.1 -> 3,841.2, -26.9%; dropping alone -26.6%; 4 beyond dropping), Jaffle Shop 6/6 (198 -> 60, -69.7%; dropping alone -59.1%; 6 beyond dropping). Actions 4,329 -> 2,505 (dropping alone 3,105). 849 of 1,448 proof steps proved (58.6%); 322 assertions over removed or rewritten tables dropped and listed.
performance: Reducer: median 5.69 s per case, max 88.45 s, 2,746 s in total on the dev split (4 workers; 60 s search limit for converted cases, 120 s for real projects and Jaffle Shop), re-proof included. Checking: 519 s.
